trial.brief_summary: This trial is conducted in China. The aim of the trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of BGM0504 versus semaglutide as add-on to metformin and/or sulfonylureas in patients with type 2 diabetes
trial.brief_title: A Study of BGM0504 in Participants with Type 2 Diabetes
trial.official_title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-Label Trial Comparing Efficacy and Safety of BGM0504 Versus Semaglutide Once Weekly As Add-on Therapy to Metformin And/or Sulfonylureas in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes
